content.short: SafePal is the first hardware wallet to natively support TON, offering a full suite of secure asset management tools.
content.description: SafePal is a comprehensive non-custodial wallet suite that was the first hardware wallet to provide native support for the TON blockchain. It offers a unique combination of hardware, software, and browser extension wallets, all integrated into a single ecosystem. SafePal's hardware solutions use air-gapped security to protect assets, while its app provides a rich interface for dApp interaction, token swaps, and yield farming, making it a powerful choice for TON users.
content.meta: Explore SafePal, the first hardware wallet with native TON support. Secure your assets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
